subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world ratio and rate word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student works through a sharing or shopping scenario using virtual objects tied to ratio or rate
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a bar model to represent a one-step ratio or rate word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a one-step ratio or rate word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot decide whether a problem calls for ratio-sharing or rate-comparison

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
